pairs.subject: production-prompt-architecture
pairs.evidence: src/components/modules/project-setup/prompts.ts:50 The create and build-verify prompts are hand-written template strings sent through raw sendPrompt, so they skip the shared builder's section skeleton and type toolchain facts straight into the prompt text.

techniques.evidence: src/components/modules/project-setup/ProjectSetupModule.tsx:108 Raw sendPrompt (useModuleCLI does no context injection) with a hand-written string. It skips PromptBuilder/buildTaskPrompt, so there are no canonical sections and no project-context header.
src/components/modules/project-setup/prompts.ts:56 The .NET 8.x toolchain floor is typed into the prompt body. src/lib/engine-facts.ts has no dotnet entry, so a UE upgrade will not update it.

pairs.subject: production-prompt-architecture
pairs.evidence: src/components/modules/core-engine/sub_ability/forge/index.tsx:74 The forge assembles through the shared PromptBuilder, but it passes no dynamicContext (so the scanned-state and do-not-recreate block is silently left out), no module (so routing takes the superset fallback and knowledge tips are dropped), and an empty wiring call that renders nothing.

techniques.evidence: src/lib/prompts/ability-forge.ts:288 Assembled by the shared builder, whose build() emits sections in a fixed order and throws when context or task is missing.

src/lib/prompts/ability-forge.ts:17 The tag inventory is a hand-typed copy of the header, not a scan. ctx has no dynamicContext, so prompt-context's 'Do NOT recreate' block is left out with no explicit empty-scan line.

src/lib/prompts/ability-forge.ts:294 Called with no reqs or moduleAssets, so formatWiringRequirements returns '' and the prompt has no wiring section, even though a GA_* class must be granted to the ASC.

src/lib/prompts/ability-forge.ts:289 No module or promptKind is passed even though the work is classified (moduleId is in scope). Gotchas take the superset fallback (prompt-context.ts:279), and knowledge-tips.ts:24 returns '' with no moduleId.

src/lib/prompts/ability-forge.ts:280 The producer is shown the grader's bar, but as a hand-restated copy of forgedAbilityRelationshipFaults in forge-errors.ts, not read from the grader's source. The two can drift.

src/components/modules/core-engine/sub_ability/forge/index.tsx:60 The project's version flows into withProjectContext, and the header reads getEngineFacts(ueVersion), which throws on an unparseable version.
